lines.text: Many learners say: I go to the gym three times in a week.
Better: I go to the gym three times a week.
Say a week to count how often.
A week! I go to the gym three times a week.

data.why: Say a week to count how often.

native.tip: 「週に〜回」は three times a week と言います。in は不要です。
native.caption: “I go to the gym three times in a week.”と言っていませんか？😅 「週に」の「に」を in で訳しがちです。“I go to the gym three times a week.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“a week”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say three times a week. No in.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I go to the gym three times in a week.” 😅 The Japanese に makes people add in. The natural way is “I go to the gym three times a week.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
